title: Geometry Plan v1
description: Structural schema for a GeometryPlan — the deterministic intermediate representation between validated JDL and Atlas execution. PLANNED: no such object is materialized in the current backend; build_solitaire_ring() goes directly from JewelryDefinition to GeneratedModel with no separate plan value in between. See docs/bible/08-alchemist/166-geometry-plan-model.md.

coordinateFrame.description: A fixed, non-negotiable constant today — see docs/bible/07-atlas/123-coordinate-system-and-orientation.md. Recorded here for future-proofing only, in case a second coordinate convention is ever introduced.

buildOrder.description: Topologically-ordered componentPlanIds, terminating with the assembly step.

buildOrderNote.description: Free-text clarification of which build-order entries are true data dependencies vs. incidental code ordering. See docs/bible/08-alchemist/169-component-build-order.md.

derivedParameters.description: Plan-level derived values shared by more than one component, e.g. band_top_z, prong_center_radius, EMBED_MM.

artifactHints.description: PLANNED — a forward hint of which artifacts will likely be requested, so Atlas execution could (in a future implementation) skip unnecessary work; not used by anything today.
